gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Noto Sans Meroitic reads friendly and unfussy, its lowercase filling the line almost like capitals. Wallpoet brings the muscle on top, and the two make a loud-then-quiet pairing that holds together.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-modi: Daylight shows inside every curve of Noto Sans Modi, and its lowercase sits close to capital height. Noto Sans Modi would carry a long page without tiring the eye, while Wallpoet shouts above it.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters generously, so tall lowercase words look sturdy without ever crowding. Noto Sans Mono does the steady everyday work of sans-serif text, whereas Wallpoet is built to command attention.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro looks dense and tall through the middle of each line, with wide entrances into every letter. Try it a notch below Wallpoet.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-multani: Modern and neutral, Noto Sans Multani shows a lofty x-height and an e with a wide gap at its terminal. Wallpoet's punch is what stands out.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Wallpoet has a smooth, unbroken path around every bend. Beneath it, Noto Sans Myanmar lays down a thick, heavy-looking band of text, and that weight against the display face's see-through gaps is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Tall, punchy and a bit stern, Noto Sans Nabataean has lowercase standing nearly cap-high with wide s curves. And Wallpoet above it, with its paper-white gaps between letters, gives the pair real presence.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Noto Sans Nag Mundari has c and s shapes that look half unwrapped, with lowercase rivaling the capitals. Noto Sans Nag Mundari sits well beneath Wallpoet if you keep it a size or two smaller.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Big, bold, then easygoing: Wallpoet leads with its high-rising lowercase. Noto Sans Nandinagari follows with short ascenders and a large body, keeping its openings generous at every weight in sans-serif style.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-newa: Wallpoet's lowercase rises high, with a smooth path around each bend and gaps showing paper between letters. But Noto Sans Newa gives the pair its footing, with a clearly open e and tall bowls.
